body: An official website of the United States government. ## Advance Economic Indicators Press Release Schedule. | **Statistical Month** | **Release Date** | **Day** |. | December 2025 | February 19, 2026 | THU |. | March 2026 | April 29, 2026 | WED |. | April 2026 | May 29, 2026 | FRI |. | May 2026 | June 26, 2026 | FRI |. | June 2026 | July 28, 2026 | TUE |. | July 2026 | August 27,2026 | THU |. | August 2026 | September 30, 2026 | WED |. | September 2026 | October 28, 2026 | WED |. | October 2026 | November 27, 2026 | FRI |. | November 2026 | December 28, 2026 | MON |. Measuring America's People, Places, and Economy. By selecting this link you will leave www.census.gov. Please check the Privacy Policy of the site you are visiting.
The U.S. Census Bureau announced updates to the 2019 economic indicator release schedule through the March statistical month.
